rules.settlements: All cities/towns, plus villages/suburbs within 3 km of an OSM river
rules.population: OSM population tag only; otherwise unknown (null)
rules.terrain: HAND proxy: settlement DEM elevation minus nearest river-sample elevation (500 m samples); ~90 m DEM, noisy on small differences
rules.flood_prone_roads: Fords; bridges within 300 m of a river; road mid-points within 300 m of a river and ≤4 m above it
rules.road_network: OSM motorway…unclassified (+links), largest connected component only
rules.units: SYNTHETIC demo units (not a real fleet), placed at OSM facilities serving the most settlements within 15 km; rescue teams/boats at police stations (no fire stations are tagged in OSM for this district)
